summary: The Admission Follow-up page provides a centralized view of all follow-up activities across the system. Users can see total follow-ups and filter them by status (today's, upcoming, overdue, completed) or by counselor and date range, acting as a comprehensive follow-up report.
steps: 3. Use the quick filters to view 'Today's Follow-ups', 'Upcoming Follow-ups', 'Overdue Follow-ups', or 'Completed Follow-ups'.
4. To check counselor-wise follow-ups, set a 'Start Date' and 'End Date' and select the desired counselor.
5. Review the details of each follow-up, including lead information and status.
business_rules: A single lead can have multiple follow-up entries.
important_notes: This page is essential for counselors and managers to track and manage all scheduled and completed follow-up activities efficiently.
Overdue follow-ups highlight pending tasks that require immediate attention.
questions: Where can I see a consolidated list of all admission follow-ups?
How do I check which follow-ups are overdue?
Can I filter follow-ups by a specific counselor and date range?
What is the difference between 'Upcoming' and 'Overdue' follow-ups?
How many follow-ups can a single lead have?
